navigation.notes: CORRECTED 2026-08-31: this seed also carried https://repository.usfca.edu/ontarioreview/sitemap.xml. Ontario Review is the Joyce Carol Oates literary magazine, not a law journal, and 238 of its PDFs are in corpus/scraped/repository.usfca.edu. Pooling it with the law review also inflated the volume range that detect_volume_gaps checks, which is most of the 64 'missing volume' warnings recorded for this host. usflawreview has 534 article pages across 24 volumes; the other volumes were never digitised to bepress, so those gaps are an upstream publication fact, not a crawl failure. PDFs are currently unreachable: /cgi/viewcontent.cgi returns Cloudflare 403, the platform-wide bepress block.
